verdict.rationale: Kushki is a payments platform, so a general automation capability is a fair question, but the pack documents no user-configurable automations or background workflows. The closest items, recurring and scheduled charge pages ('Crea un cargo recurrente', 'Maneja tus cargos calendarizados'), describe subscription billing. That is an adjacent payment feature, not general autonomous automations, and the pages are title-only with no detail.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
